package.name: surgical_task_coordinator
package.description:
Take-turn sequencer for the surgical robot: decides which ONE of the three perception algorithms (tool detection, hand keypoints, blood detection) may run at any moment, and drives the robot's grasp, handover and suction operations between them.
Deliberately depends on none of the three algorithms -- it talks to them only through the ROS 2 lifecycle interface and geometry_msgs/PoseStamped results, so each team keeps its own repository, its own virtual environment and its own dependencies.
